summary: Completed backend-only source-level regression testing for MIS Operations PDF empty-trend edge case. Verified unavailable note is shown when twelve_month_operational_trends is missing/empty and when all series values are None. Verified available chart rendering and odd-row spacer padding behavior remain intact.
action_items: No further fixes required for the requested scope.
critical_code_review_comments: _sec_incidents_compliance now correctly emits the unavailable note for missing/empty operational trends input, preventing blank-state output.
Operational trend charts remain constrained to available series with expected spec mapping and odd-row padding via Spacer.
Maintainability note: /app/backend/modules/mis_reports/pdf_builder.py is >700 lines and should be split into focused modules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run was pure source-level pytest only (no API calls, delivery, email, or data mutation). Reuse the same test file for future regression on operational trend availability messaging and chart-row layout.
rca of the issue: Prior RCA (iter151) confirmed the root cause: missing/empty trends bypassed unavailable-note rendering due to truthiness guard. Current retest validates mitigation is effective across empty dict and all-None series paths.
